Extracted requirements from spec/appendix-bufferbloat.md section 2 (Time-Based Expiry):

MUST/SHALL Checklist:
[x] R1 (MUST): Packets MUST have deadlines - IMPL: TxQueueEntry.deadline_ms
[x] R2 (MUST): Packets past deadline MUST be silently dropped - IMPL: TxQueue._expire_deadlines()
[x] R3 (SHOULD): Default deadline for routing control: 5s - IMPL: DEADLINE_ROUTING_MS=5000
[!] R4 (SHOULD): Default deadline for ACK/NACK: 10s - IMPL DEVIATION: 5s (aliased to ROUTING, intentional design)
[x] R5 (SHOULD): Default deadline for app data: 60s configurable - IMPL: DEADLINE_APP_MS=60000

Note: Spec uses plain language, not RFC 2119 keywords. The ACK=5s deviation is documented in code as intentional aliasing to routing priority.
